text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Not a single cloud over Diamond's 
brilliance! The winner of the Osaka Hai is 
Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
You left no openings, Satono Diamond! Your 
running is as beautiful as ever.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her strength is reminiscent of Kitasan 
Black's breakout year last season. ...No, 
she might be even stronger...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black isn't the type to end things 
here, either. Satono versus Kitasan... I 
can't wait to see what's next...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, both Kita-chan and Dia-chan have 
grown up so splendidly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From whose perspective are you 
speaking...? Though, I do agree.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them race kind of 
reminded me of our head-to-head match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring), isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps... the next race for those two as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Maybe so~. ...By the way, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm in a reeeeeeally, really big mood to 
run right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence. I am as well, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wanna run all the way back to the 
station?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ughhhhh, this is so frustrating!! My goal 
was to completely sweep the Senior Class 
Royal Road!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Stumbling right at the start?! Uggghhh, 
seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: K-Kita-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't pull away from Dia-chan at all! 
And after all that crazy hard training I 
did, too...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And yet, they still catch up to me! Or 
rather, I get passed, or they say I let my 
guard down at the end!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my gosh, oh my gosh! That's our 
Dia-chan for you!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'm doing everything I can not to 
get left behind by Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy I could race all-out against 
Dia-chan! I want to run with her even 
more!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to defeat Dia-chan when she's at 
her best! That's why... I want you to run 
in the Tenno Sho (Spring)!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)... That's the race 
where Kita-chan's back-to-back victory is 
on the line, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want to run the longest GⅠ, the 
3,200m, together with Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Talk it over with your Trainer and think 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting in Kyoto!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, about the next race...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...But why?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond said that while chasing 
after Kitasan Black, she wants to ponder 
what it truly means to be a "legendary 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I had anticipated entering the 
races that Kitasan Black is aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I figured Satono Diamond would 
intentionally challenge Kitasan Black in 
the Tenno Sho (Spring)— a race where 
Kitasan excels and is aiming for 
consecutive wins.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So you see right through everything. 
...Hm, then it seems there should be no 
problem with me making on-the-spot 
decisions from now on.
choice_data_list: No, at least consult me first?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then, next up is the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Let us bring the historic shield 
and its honor home to the Satono family.
